# Sales Dashboard Recommendation

This dataset is small but very usable for a simple executive dashboard. The clearest story is monthly revenue growth by region, plus whether growth is coming from more orders or higher average order value.

# Recommended Charts and Key Insights

## 1) Revenue Trend by Month and Region
- Chart type: **Line chart**
- X-axis: Month
- Y-axis: Revenue
- Series: North America, Europe
- Best insight: Shows overall growth pattern and whether one region is leading or closing the gap.

## 2) Orders Trend by Month and Region
- Chart type: **Line chart** or **clustered column chart**
- X-axis: Month
- Y-axis: Orders
- Series: North America, Europe
- Best insight: Reveals whether revenue changes are supported by demand volume.

## 3) Average Order Value by Month and Region
- Chart type: **Line chart**
- X-axis: Month
- Y-axis: Revenue / Orders
- Series: North America, Europe
- Best insight: Shows whether customers are spending more per order over time.

## Executive Summary

- **North America leads revenue in all 3 months**, but Europe is growing steadily and narrowing the gap.
- **Both revenue and orders rise overall from January to February**, with a slight softening in North America revenue in March while orders stay relatively stable.
- The most useful diagnostic is **Average Order Value (AOV)**, because it separates growth from higher order counts versus higher spending per order.

## Metric to Track Growth Driver

**Average Order Value (AOV) = Revenue ÷ Orders**

Use this metric to tell whether revenue growth is driven more by:
- **Order volume growth** if orders rise while AOV stays flat
- **Pricing / basket-size growth** if AOV rises even when orders are stable

### Quick read from your data
- **North America AOV**
  - Jan: about **$353**
  - Feb: about **$375**
  - Mar: about **$361**
- **Europe AOV**
  - Jan: about **$338**
  - Feb: about **$331**
  - Mar: about **$349**

This suggests:
- **North America’s February growth** looks driven by both more orders and higher AOV.
- **Europe’s March improvement** appears more AOV-led than volume-led.

## Quick Actions
- Action: [Button: Build dashboard] https://www.google.com/search?q=dashboard+design+sales+revenue+orders+aov
- Action: [Button: Calculate AOV] https://www.google.com/search?q=average+order+value+formula

## Sources
- Revenue and order analysis method: https://www.investopedia.com/terms/a/aov.asp
- General dashboard best practices: https://www.tableau.com/learn/articles/dashboard-design-best-practices
